name: graphify-intelligence-layer
goal: Compose Graphify with LoopGraph to provide scoped code intelligence, conflict-aware isolated execution, and architecture-aware verification.

loops.title: Project graph contract and durable context
loops.objective: Add a harness-neutral project graph provider boundary, pass context into loop requests, and persist per-loop context packets.
tasks: Define provider, snapshot, query, context, and impact types
Integrate optional graph preflight and loop queries into GraphRuntime
Persist context packets atomically under .loopgraph/context
Cover lifecycle, request propagation, and persistence with tests

loops.title: Graphify CLI provider
loops.objective: Implement an explicit Graphify CLI provider for graph preflight, incremental refresh, and scoped natural-language queries.
tasks: Wrap Graphify commands without shell interpolation
Support configurable binary and graph paths
Bound captured output and surface actionable errors
Extract project-local file citations into structured context
Add an opt-in CLI flag and deterministic provider tests

loops.title: Graph-aware loop compilation
loops.objective: Enrich requirements compilation with architectural communities, central nodes, dependency paths, and likely touch sets.
tasks: Define a compact compiler context contract
Query project structure before compiling unstructured requirements
Prefer subsystem and contract boundaries when creating loops
Generate an integration loop for independent implementation workstreams
Test deterministic fallback behavior when no graph provider is configured

completionConditions.description: Graph compilation consumes bounded architectural evidence while preserving valid LoopGraph version 1 output and no-provider compatibility.

loops.title: Isolated worktree execution
loops.objective: Add a workspace manager and worktree-capable adapter lifecycle so independent loops can execute without sharing mutable files.
tasks: Define workspace allocation and cleanup contracts
Create one branch and worktree per loop using validated identifiers
Record workspace metadata under .loopgraph/workspaces
Support cancellation and recoverable cleanup
Keep merging under supervisor control

completionConditions.description: Independent loops can execute in isolated Git worktrees and return commit and changed-file evidence without self-merging.

loops.title: Conflict and architecture impact planning
loops.objective: Estimate overlapping write sets and graph impact so dependency-independent loops are only parallelized when safe.
tasks: Model file, node, community, and dependency-proximity overlap
Define deterministic score thresholds and hard serialization rules
Persist before and after impact reports
Add no-new-cycle and unexpected-impact checks
Test stable scheduling decisions

completionConditions.description: The scheduler deterministically serializes unsafe overlaps and records evidence for every graph-based decision.

loops.title: Supervisor-controlled integration
loops.objective: Integrate completed loop branches in dependency order, verify the combined system, refresh the graph, and produce a durable handoff.
tasks: Generate and persist a merge plan
Integrate shared contracts before dependent implementations
Resolve or block on conflicts without losing worker branches
Run the full test and typecheck suite
Refresh Graphify and run final architecture checks
